benchmark_summary.claim_limit: Authored development contracts in registered schemas only; no application task success, domain qualification, statistical independence, novelty or performance advantage established.
benchmark_summary.timing_scope: Every attempted evaluation and certificate check is counted, including failures and timeouts. Unavailable timings stay null; totals sum observed samples only and are null when none were measured. evaluation_ns includes function work and excludes import/startup; worker_wall_ns includes process startup, imports and capture. Reference timing is separate; all_invocation_timing includes references, solvers and checks, not parent-runner overhead. Fresh workers; no persistent warm cache or performance inference.

certificate.memory_scope: OS process high-water mark observed after input post-check and result JSON serialization, before final reply output. Includes interpreter/import/input overhead; excludes the parent and other workers. Maxima across sequential workers are reported, never summed or called solver-only memory.
certificate.timing_scope: preparation_ns starts at worker entry and includes job JSON loading, input digest and target import; wrapper/benchmark imports occur before entry. evaluation_ns covers the function attempt, including failures. Result JSON validation/serialization and input post-check are separate. worker_body_ns includes resource observation but excludes final reply serialization/write; worker_wall_ns includes process startup and output. These timings overlap and must not all be added together.

evaluation.memory_scope: OS process high-water mark observed after input post-check and result JSON serialization, before final reply output. Includes interpreter/import/input overhead; excludes the parent and other workers. Maxima across sequential workers are reported, never summed or called solver-only memory.
